content.text:
We need answer only JSON per schema. Need extract claims. Review: title "Cracks easily"; source_text "Cracks easily\nI have gone through 2 of the 3 screen protectors in 2 days. One little drop and it cracks bad". Product likely screen protector. Claims: reliability_durability / cracking_breakage? Yes evidence "Cracks easily" and "One little drop and it cracks bad". Also short_lifespan? "gone through 2 of the 3 screen protectors in 2 days" indicates short lifespan? We need exactly one valid primary/secondary pair per claim. We can include multiple claims. Need independent polarity. Do not infer sentiment from star rating. Evidence exact continuous substring. Need no invent.

Potential claims:
1. primary reliability_durability secondary cracking_breakage polarity negative evidence "Cracks easily" or "One little drop and it cracks bad". This is product claim.
2. primary reliability_durability secondary short_lifespan polarity negative evidence "I have gone through 2 of the 3 screen protectors in 2 days." Is that a product claim? It says went through 2 in 2 days, implying short lifespan/durability. Could be reliability_durability short_lifespan. But maybe overlapping with cracking breakage. We can include both if distinct: one about cracking, one about short lifespan. Need exact substring. Source text: "Cracks easily\nI have gone through 2 of the 3 screen protectors in 2 days. One little drop and it cracks bad". Note newline. Evidence span must exact continuous substring from SOURCE_TEXT. Could use "Cracks easily" without newline. Or "One little drop and it cracks bad". For short lifespan: "I have gone through 2 of the 3 screen protectors in 2 days." Exact includes period. Good.

Polarity negative for both.

Need ensure taxonomy secondary valid enum: cracking_breakage, short_lifespan. Primary reliability_durability valid. Maybe "defective_on_arrival"? No, cracks after drop, not DOA. "product_quality material_build_quality"? Cracks easily could be build quality, but taxonomy has cracking_breakage under reliability_durability. More specific. So use that.

Need final JSON only. No markdown. Ensure valid JSON.

{"claims":[{"primary_topic":"reliability_durability","secondary_topic":"cracking_breakage","polarity":"negative","evidence_span":"Cracks easily"},{"primary_topic":"reliability_durability","secondary_topic":"short_lifespan","polarity":"negative","evidence_span":"I have gone through 2 of the 3 screen protectors in 2 days."}]}
